rationale: The PLP likely failed to render due to an unhandled cookie consent (OneTrust) and dynamic, JS-driven rendering. Adding a reliable consent click and waiting/scrolling improves materialization. Moncler commonly uses data-testid-based hooks for grid and tiles; the added selectors cover both data-testid and class-based variants seen across locales/AB tests. URL normalization ensures we stay on en-int and avoid locale traps or monclergroup.com redirects, and preserves the GB shipping context for consistent pricing.
code_hints: After navigation, first click the OneTrust button (#onetrust-accept-btn-handler) if present, then wait for either [data-testid='product-grid'] or product tiles to appear.
Use a visible-only wait: page.waitForSelector('[data-testid="product-tile"]', { visible: true, timeout: 15000 }) before declaring PLP failure.
If tiles are still missing after 8s, perform incremental scroll (800px steps) with short delays to trigger lazy render, then re-check.
When extracting PLP links, prefer the first anchor matching the product_link selectors within each product_card; de-duplicate by href.
Preserve/merge the query params forceLocale=en-int and shipToCountry=GB when following PDP links.
On PDP, read price from [itemprop=price] or [data-testid=price] [data-testid=amount]; ensure the element has non-empty textContent or a content/value attribute before accepting.
